name: Crusader Road Acolyte
text: You trained with the Hellknights at Fort Inevitable or the paladins of Iomedae at Fort Riverwatch. If you trained with the Hellknights, you gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws against chaotic spells and the spell-like abilities of chaotic outsiders. If you trained with the Iomedaean Paladins, you gain this bonus against evil spells and evil outsiders instead.
